Hi David — sorry about the friction here, and thanks for flagging it.

Short answer: we see this occasionally around DST boundaries where Calendly/Chili Piper caches an earlier timezone or the browser locale doesn't update correctly. Two quick workarounds you can try:

- In Calendly, expand the timezone dropdown and explicitly pick "(UTC+01:00) Amsterdam/Berlin" — then refresh the page.
- If that still shows Pacific times, click the Chili Piper link below (fallback routing) — it's a separate scheduler that tends to respect the browser timezone.

If neither works, I can propose manual slots and send a Google Calendar invite so the timezone is explicit. Are any of these work for you? You mentioned Tue/Wed 14:00-17:00 CEST — I can propose:

- Wed Jun 3, 15:00 CEST (09:00 PDT)
- Wed Jun 3, 16:00 CEST (10:00 PDT)

I'll also loop in our SE (Alex) and AE (Marissa) so we can lock a time that matches your calendar.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo?override_timezone=true
Chili Piper (fallback): https://app.chilipiper.com/meeting/redwood/demo

If you'd rather we send a direct invite, say which time and we'll send the ICS.
